newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan chip-related shares rise in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Japan chip-related shares rise in Tokyo.

text.p: Japanese semiconductor-related shares gained ground on Friday, as investors extended their purchases to stocks related to the major global issues, which have risen recently on the weak yen, brokers said.
Shares in Tokyo Electron Ltd, which makes semiconductor-manufacturing equipment, jumped to the highest level for this financial year. At 0354 GMT, the share price was up 110 yen at 4,500 yen.
Dainippon Screen Manufacturing Co Ltd, which also makes semiconductor-manufacturing equipment, rose in active trade.
The share price of Dainippon Screen was up 20 yen at 1,060 yen at 0401 GMT. Its volume was 2.757 million shares, 19th heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"The issue is gaining attention as a laggard among semiconductor-related issues," said a broker at a major Japanese securities house.
